query:
SELECT 
  rankingType,
  timeRange,
  JSON_LENGTH(rankingData) as cardCount,
  JSON_EXTRACT(rankingData, '$[0].name') as topCardName,
  JSON_EXTRACT(rankingData, '$[0].currentPrice') as topCardCurrentPrice,
  JSON_EXTRACT(rankingData, '$[0].priceChangePercent') as topCardPriceChange,
  calculatedAt
FROM trendingRankingsCache
ORDER BY rankingType, timeRange;
